opening_01.speaker: narrator
opening_01.text: Once, men begged the gods to spare them from death.

opening_03.speaker: narrator
opening_03.text: They built bodies that could not grow old. Thrones that could not be inherited. Kingdoms that could not escape them.

opening_04.speaker: narrator
opening_04.text: But even eternity could not protect them from the people they ruled.

opening_05.speaker: narrator
opening_05.text: The crowns shattered. Their kingdoms fell. And for three hundred years, humanity believed itself free.

awakening_03.speaker: lyra
awakening_03.text: Someone who has been waiting a very long time.

awakening_05.speaker: lyra
awakening_05.text: That depends. What do you remember?

awakening_06.speaker: player
awakening_06.text: Things I couldn't possibly have seen.

first_road_01.speaker: lyra
first_road_01.text: The doors above you open onto what was a fortress. Walk. Your body remembers how, even if you don't.

first_road_02.speaker: lyra
first_road_02.text: Tap where you want to go. If something stands in the way, it has been standing there a long time.

courtyard_0_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_0_01.text: Those statues were kings once. People prayed to them. Some of them answered.

courtyard_1_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_1_01.text: Look at its armour. Under the plate there is light. That is not rust moving it.

courtyard_2_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_2_01.text: It salutes before it strikes. Someone taught it manners, three hundred years ago.

courtyard_3_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_3_01.text: That winch will hold. Most things they built still do. That is rather the problem.

courtyard_4_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_4_01.text: Careful. The big ones were made for breaking gates. You are much smaller than a gate.

courtyard_5_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_5_01.text: Rest. That candle is not a candle, but it will not hurt you.

courtyard_6_01.speaker: lyra
courtyard_6_01.text: He is still at his post. He has not been told that there is nothing left behind him.

sentinel_retry_01.speaker: sentinel
sentinel_retry_01.text: Your oath must be stronger than mine.

sentinel_death_03.speaker: sentinel
sentinel_death_03.text: Then why did no one return for me?

sentinel_memory_01.speaker: archivist
sentinel_memory_01.text: Record incomplete. Witness deceased. Memory retained.

sentinel_memory_02.speaker: archivist
sentinel_memory_02.text: Subject: gate sergeant, forty-one years of service. Volunteered. He was told it would be for one winter.

sentinel_memory_03.speaker: lyra
sentinel_memory_03.text: They were people. All of them. Remember that when the next one raises its sword.

sanctuary_return_01.speaker: lyra
sanctuary_return_01.text: You came back by the door this time. I prefer it.

sanctuary_return_02.speaker: lyra
sanctuary_return_02.text: There is a smith here. He does not trust you. He is very good. Let him look at that sword.

orren_intro_01.speaker: orren
orren_intro_01.text: So you're what she woke up. Hm.

orren_intro_02.speaker: orren
orren_intro_02.text: That sword is older than my entire bloodline. Try not to drop it.

orren_intro_03.speaker: orren
orren_intro_03.text: Bring me shards and coin. Your armour remembers its shape. I just remind it.

orren_idle_01.speaker: orren
orren_idle_01.text: People spend their lives searching for legendary weapons. Most of them wouldn't know what to do with one.

rebirth_0_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_0_01.text: You returned sooner than I expected.

rebirth_1_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_1_01.text: Your body has recovered. Your memories are another matter.

rebirth_2_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_2_01.text: You remembered something this time, didn't you?

rebirth_3_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_3_01.text: The system is learning from you.

rebirth_4_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_4_01.text: You're becoming someone it cannot predict.

rebirth_5_01.speaker: lyra
rebirth_5_01.text: Those memories aren't orders. You don't owe the dead your future.

executioner_intro_03.speaker: executioner
executioner_intro_03.text: The law does not require a kingdom.

executioner_death_01.speaker: lyra
executioner_death_01.text: That prison was switched back on from somewhere else. Someone is waking them. On purpose.

huntsman_intro_01.speaker: huntsman
huntsman_intro_01.text: I have hunted what the old kings bred. I know one of their things when I see it.

widow_intro_01.speaker: widow
widow_intro_01.text: That stance. I knew the soldier who taught it.

widow_intro_03.speaker: widow
widow_intro_03.text: No. But someone inside you has.

widow_death_01.speaker: widow
widow_death_01.text: You fight like six people I buried. And none of them.

beast_intro_01.speaker: lyra
beast_intro_01.text: That was grown, not born. Do not look for a man inside it.

gravewarden_intro_03.speaker: gravewarden
gravewarden_intro_03.text: People waiting for someone to remember their names.

gravewarden_death_01.speaker: archivist
gravewarden_death_01.text: You are not the first to enter this chamber. You are merely the first it has permitted to leave.

gravewarden_death_02.speaker: archivist
gravewarden_death_02.text: History has been rewritten seventeen times. Would you prefer the surviving version?

frostking_intro_01.speaker: frostking
frostking_intro_01.text: I watched men become gods. Then I watched gods become machines.

frostking_intro_02.speaker: player
frostking_intro_02.text: Why didn't you destroy the Crown?

frostking_intro_03.speaker: frostking
frostking_intro_03.text: Because there were still people inside it.

frostking_retry_01.speaker: frostking
frostking_retry_01.text: Every resurrection makes the chains harder to break.

frostking_death_01.speaker: frostking
frostking_death_01.text: Go to the capital. Do better than we did. It will not be difficult.

wyrm_intro_01.speaker: lyra
wyrm_intro_01.text: They built her to break sieges. She has had centuries to decide what else she is.

monarch_intro_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_intro_01.text: Look upon what remains of our civilization.

monarch_intro_02.speaker: player
monarch_intro_02.text: I see a kingdom that should have been allowed to die.

monarch_intro_03.speaker: monarch
monarch_intro_03.text: And I see children who will never wake if these machines fall silent.

monarch_intro_04.speaker: player
monarch_intro_04.text: How many people have you sacrificed?

monarch_intro_05.speaker: monarch
monarch_intro_05.text: Enough to ensure there are still people left to ask that question.

monarch_retry_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_retry_01.text: You still believe death cannot teach you surrender.

monarch_death_01.speaker: monarch
monarch_death_01.text: I have counted every life this machine has taken. Have you counted the lives it has saved?

monarch_death_02.speaker: lyra
monarch_death_02.text: I think I remember the rain.
